title: I Saved the Entire Sect by Slacking Off
title_original: 我靠擺爛拯救了全宗門
summary:
Ye Qiao, an exhausted modern corporate worker, transmigrates into a popular xianxia harem novel as the tragic cannon-fodder "Second Senior Sister." In the original storyline, she was destined to block blades and give up her spiritual roots for the sheltered white-lotus female lead.

Refusing to be a stepping stone, Ye Qiao packs up overnight, defects from her toxic sect, and joins the impoverished Changming Sect. Her only goal: lie flat and be a total slacker. However, she discovers her new senior brothers are all doomed tragic geniuses from the original plot. Through absurd "slacker" antics, relentless modern logic, and accidental overpowered feats, she derails the tragic script, dragging her entire sect into comedic chaos and saving them all.

title: The Villain Disciples Are All Simps? The Slacking Shizun Runs Wild
title_original: 反派弟子全舔狗？摆烂师尊浪浪浪
summary:
After furiously venting about a webnovel where the angelic female lead hoarded every peerless handsome man, Qin Ran woke up to find herself transmigrated into that very book—as the cross-dressing, sadistic Shizun of the four future supreme villains.

In the original plot, this abusive master tortured her disciples while they were weak, only to suffer gruesome retribution: a century of unspeakable agony before having her bones crushed to ash.

Faced with this guaranteed death flag, Qin Ran made a decisive life choice: Since she was already dealt the villainess hand, why bother trying hard? Time to slack off completely, eat snacks, and run wild!

She spent her days lecturing her disciples on the tragic fates of shameless simps while quietly stacking her defense stats to invulnerable heights. But to her utter bewilderment, her reverse psychology backfired in the most bizarre way imaginable:

Eldest Disciple, the future ruthless Demon Emperor: "Shizun, that sword looks decent." —Instantly snatches the female lead's sacred blade to offer to his master.

Second Disciple, the peerless poison-and-medicine genius: "Shizun, is this spirit herb nourishing?" —Concocts the female lead's destined herb into divine pills for Qin Ran.

Third Disciple, the angelic talisman prodigy with a split persona: "Shizun wishes to see snow?" —Conjures an artificial blizzard that leaves the female lead shivering in tears.

Fourth Disciple, the dormant White Tiger Beast God: "Shizun is hungry?" —Catches the female lead's bonded divine beast and turns it into a savory stew.

The impoverished, desolate sect was somehow slacked off into the most terrifying powerhouse in the entire cultivation realm. And to make matters worse, as her disciples gradually discovered that their cold, slacking master was actually a devastatingly beautiful woman in disguise, the way they looked at her became increasingly heated...

title: Quick Transmigration: The Demon Venerable Is Righteously Evil
title_original: 快穿之魔尊他邪的发正
summary:
【Quick Transmigration】【No Fixed CP】

Shi Nian was once the legendary Demon Venerable who made the three realms tremble—a peerless existence who was neither purely righteous nor truly wicked, but governed solely by his own heart. He bowed to no heaven, knelt to no earth, and defied the so-called 'Heavenly Dao and moral orthodoxy.' He never harmed the innocent, yet whoever dared provoke him was thoroughly obliterated!

To eradicate him, the self-proclaimed 'Righteous Path' gathered the full might of the seven grand sects and thirty-six factions. At the cost of burning the essence-blood and souls of thousands of elite cultivators, they cast the Eternal Demon-Slaying Array to suppress him deep beneath the Demon Subduing Abyss. Incapable of killing him, they could only seek to wear down his iron-willed divine soul inch by agonizing inch across the ages.

This suppression lasted for ten thousand years! The once-invincible Demon Venerable, whose hand could tear the skies and overturn the oceans, was reduced to a fragile remnant soul. Just as Shi Nian thought his consciousness would finally fade into nothingness, an entity calling itself a 'System' appeared and pulled him out of the abyss.

From that moment on, Shi Nian began his journey through three thousand worlds—mending his divine soul and reforging his supreme demonic body:
'Righteous Path... every debt you owe me, I will collect in full, drop by drop!'

He is Shi Nian; neither heaven nor earth can halt his path, and the vast cosmos cannot bind him!
schedule: فصلين يومياً | 9:00 ص و 4:00 م (بتوقيت بغداد)

title: My Childhood Friends Are All Game Bosses
summary:
"Please, I am the young master of the mutant Demon gene family in Night City—could you girls stop feeding me soft rice?!"

In a vast game world where thousands of races stand tall, gene evolution, martial arts, sci-fi cultivation, magic, and superpowers fiercely collide amid endless territorial wars. 

Ye Ge is reincarnated into a demonized mutant clan, bearing the bloodline of the Demon King. Nightwatchers, Demon Hunters, Superpower Guilds, Magic Guilds, and Cultivation Guilds all brand him an existential catastrophe that must be eliminated at all costs. 

In the original game storyline, Ye Ge was destined to die young. Following his death, his sweet childhood female companions all blackened into humanity's most feared final villainous BOSSes, while his entire clan was slaughtered by the self-proclaimed righteous factions. 

Reborn at the age of seven, Ye Ge awakens a Sign-In System. Through ten years of silent daily sign-ins, he unlocks all-class talents, forbidden abilities, and mythical demon beasts, quietly manipulating the chessboard of the future.

Watching his childhood sweethearts display increasingly terrifying boss potentials, Ye Ge steps onto a dominating path—opposing all of humanity while holding the true destiny of the world firmly in his grasp!
schedule: 2 Chapters Daily | 9:00 AM & 4:00 PM (Baghdad Time GMT+3)

title: After Being Expelled from the Prince's Mansion, I Became the Strongest Jinyiwei
title_original: 被趕出王府後，我成了最強錦衣衛
summary:
Transmigrating into another world, Lin Fan became the heir to the Prince of Peerless Status. Right at the beginning, he was framed for molestation and ruthlessly expelled from the mansion.

Starting from nothing, he chose to join the feared Jinyiwei (Embroidered Uniform Guard) — the Emperor's lethal secret police feared by corrupt officials and powerful martial clans alike.

With iron discipline and an indomitable will, Lin Fan rises through the bloody ranks, unravelling royal conspiracies and ascending to become the absolute strongest Jinyiwei the empire has ever witnessed.
